_: The saga filter lists TMDb collections (themoviedb.org/collection/…) with at least 2 films in the catalogue: nothing to do for those. This file covers the rest. 'sagas': series TMDb doesn't group, by TMDb film ids (a film here leaves its TMDb collection). 'names': rename a TMDb collection, by collection id. 'exclude': collection ids to leave out. Every build logs the sagas it found.
